findings.summary: Generated CST evidence does not independently verify coarse block classification.
Oracle reachability analysis stops at file boundaries and permits cross-file production coupling.
Mutant validation does not prove that the declared semantic defect matches the anchored mutation.
Substring-based ruling matching can suppress unrelated verified findings.
